cases.description: Remove all records from the QUESTION section (section 0). After the call, the internal sections array entry for index 0 must be null and the header count for that section must be reset to 0.
Remove all records from the ANSWER section (section 1). Verify that the section entry is cleared and the header count is set to 0.
Remove all records from the AUTHORITY section (section 2). Ensure proper nulling of the array element and header count reset.
Remove all records from the ADDITIONAL section (section 3). Confirm that the method clears the section and updates the header count.
Pass a negative section index. Section.check should reject the value and the method must throw an IllegalArgumentException.
Pass an index greater than the highest valid section (assuming sections are 0‑3). Section.check should throw an IllegalArgumentException.
Pass a far‑out‑of‑range index. The method must still rely on Section.check to raise an IllegalArgumentException.
The Message instance has its header field set to null (e.g., via reflection). Calling removeAllRecords should attempt header.setCount and throw a NullPointerException.
With a null header and a valid section index, the method must still raise a NullPointerException when trying to update the header count.
The internal sections array is null (e.g., set via reflection). removeAllRecords should attempt to assign to sections[section] and throw a NullPointerException.
When sections is null and a valid section index is provided, the method must fail with a NullPointerException before reaching header.setCount.
